text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've invited Light Hello on a fun day out
to give
her a break. When I arrive at our
meet-up spot...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
All right, we'll bring in the audio
equipment
tomorrow. I appreciate the
help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Growl...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I forgot about lunch. Work really
runs me
ragged.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer! Apologies for not noticing
you there!
choice_data_list: Would you like to eat first?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm completely fine! Forgetting a meal
here or
there is something I've gotten
quite used to—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Groooowl...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Urk... You're right. What would be the
point of
this day out if I collapsed from
hunger?
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself too hard isn't good.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Well, there is somewhere nearby we
could eat at.
It's a restaurant I used to
go to all the time.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Wow... this takes me back. It hasn't
changed at all
since my school years.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh! And they're still doing the dessert of
the
week! Who'd have thought?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
It was! My friends and I used to order it
all the
time. ♪
choice_data_list: Is that a familiar dish to you?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
We savored our so-called "pre-workout
nutrient
boost" bite by bite...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And sure enough, we'd still be eating
long after it
was time for training. You
can bet my trainer was
not thrilled about
that.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
But once we found out what the
following week's
dessert would be, we
quickly made plans to go
again. Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That goes without saying! We couldn't
get
enough.
choice_data_list: So that was the trending dessert everyone's talking about.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
It was so popular, word of mouth spread
the news
faster than the academy
flyers...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Word of mouth! I forgot that
was an
option!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Most students that age get info from
their friends
or family. If we could
incorporate that into our
advertising
strategy, then...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. ♪ Taking a break sure has its
perks! I'll
need to keep maximizing the
use of any time I
have off work.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Where's my notepad?! I need to jot all
this down
before I forget...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I did it again, didn't I? I'm always planning a hundred steps ahead...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem like Light Hello can
resist the
temptation to always put her
work first. In that
case...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I would really appreciate that,
but...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but think I'm causing you to
worry for
my sake...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh... that makes sense. You are quite
busy
yourself, Trainer.
choice_data_list: I've been wondering how to take a breather, too.
I've been wondering how to unwind myself.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Okay then. As long as it's not too much
trouble
for you.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Let's take some time every now and then
to
recharge!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Light Hello and I start hanging
out to
unwind from work.
